about: Behavior docs search must keep on the built index, which scripts/checks/search.mjs checks after the query sets. readAs is how search must read the query, null for as typed, so a real word is never rewritten. suggestion is a correction it may only offer. first is the place the first result must open, and top3 lists places one of which must be among the first three results
